description: The text of a provision as it was in force on a date, with the law that last changed it, the next change, its history in brief, and any limit of the record that applies. Several provisions in one answer: give paths, or a folder (an act) as path.

date.description: An in-force date, YYYY-MM-DD, or "today". Defaults to today.

include_text.description: false for dates, laws, sources and notes only (default true).

max_chars.description: Longest part of the text in one answer (default 40000, at least 1000, at most 100000). A longer text comes in parts.

offset.description: Where the part starts, in characters: the offset the previous part gave for the next one (default 0).

path.description: A provision file, for example united-states/federal/usc/title-11/1182.md, from find_provision. Or a folder (an act): its provisions are read in order.

paths.description: Several provision files to read in one answer (up to 20), instead of path.

name: read_law
title: Read law
